search_text: published ZDI-25-696 ZDI-CAN-25549 Avast Cleanup Premium TuneupSvc Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability 2025-07-29 CVE-2024-13961 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-13961 7.8 AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Avast'] ['Cleanup Premium'] This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Avast Cleanup Premium. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Avast Cleanup Service. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a directory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in Avast Cleanup 24.3-SU1 - 24.3.17165.19178 ['2024-11-05 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2025-07-29 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2025-07-29 - Advisory Updated'] Vladislav Berghici https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-25-696/
title: Avast Cleanup Premium TuneupSvc Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to delete a directory.
